zh_CN: 午后的走廊里，一名穿白大褂的女医生正低头翻看影像报告，步子很快。
en: In the afternoon corridor, a woman in a white coat hurries along, looking down at an imaging report.

zh_CN: 「咦？之前好像没见过你……」
en: “Hm? I don't think I've seen you before...”

zh_CN: 「那个，能打扰一下吗？」
en: “Excuse me. Could I have a moment?”

zh_CN: 她像是没听见一样，径直从坂口身边走了过去。
en: As though she hasn't heard him, she walks straight past Sakaguchi.

zh_CN: 「……还真是彻底地没听见啊。」
en: “...She really didn't hear a word, did she?”

zh_CN: 「您在叫御園医生？她是影像科的御園芹香医生。」
en: “Were you calling Dr. Misono? That's Dr. Serika Misono from Radiology.”

zh_CN: 「她一直这么忙吗？」
en: “Is she always this busy?”

zh_CN: 「报告总是准时出来。至于人嘛……您刚才也见到了。」
en: “Her reports are always on time. As for the doctor herself... well, you just saw.”

zh_CN: 女医生已经消失在走廊尽头。坂口回想了一下，发现自己连自我介绍的机会都没有。
en: The doctor has already disappeared around the end of the corridor. Thinking back, Sakaguchi realizes he never even had a chance to introduce himself.

zh_CN: 休息室的一角，御園芹香正一个人研究影像资料。桌上的饮料放得很近，她却连碰都没碰。
en: In a corner of the staff lounge, Serika Misono studies a set of images alone. A drink sits close at hand, untouched.

zh_CN: 「御園医生吧？上次在走廊见过。我是外科的坂口隆司。」
en: “Dr. Misono, right? We met in the corridor. I'm Ryuji Sakaguchi from Surgery.”

zh_CN: 「你是负责我们科影像会诊的？我一直想找机会——」
en: “Are you the one handling imaging consultations for our department? I've been meaning to—”

zh_CN: 「报告在系统里。片子、所见、结论，全部写了。」
en: “The report is in the system. Images, findings, conclusions. It's all there.”

zh_CN: 「我是想先认识一下同事。」
en: “I just wanted to get to know a colleague.”

zh_CN: 「需要补充判断，请走正式会诊流程。」
en: “If you need a further assessment, use the formal consultation process.”

zh_CN: 「总不能连喝杯茶都得填会诊单吧？」
en: “Surely I don't need a consultation form just to have a cup of tea?”

zh_CN: 「那不是我的会诊范围。」
en: “That's outside my consultation scope.”

zh_CN: 她已经把谈话结束了。尽管两个人面对面坐着，距离似乎比上次那条走廊还远。
en: She has already ended the conversation. They are sitting face to face, yet the distance seems greater than it was in that corridor.

zh_CN: 「朝仓，问你一个人。影像科的御園芹香，你认识吗？」
en: “Asakura, let me ask you about someone. Do you know Serika Misono in Radiology?”

zh_CN: 「认识呀。我们以前就在一起工作过。」
en: “I do. We used to work together.”

zh_CN: 「她对所有人都那么冷淡？」
en: “Is she that cold to everyone?”

zh_CN: 「御園医生的报告有问题吗？」
en: “Is there a problem with Dr. Misono's reports?”

zh_CN: 「那倒没有。内容很仔细，标注也很清楚。就是本人完全不想和我讲话。」
en: “No, not at all. They're thorough, and the annotations are clear. It's just that she won't talk to me.”

zh_CN: 「那她大概已经把该说的都写在报告里了。」
en: “Then perhaps she's already put everything she needs to say in her reports.”

zh_CN: 「……你这是在帮她解释，还是在笑我？」
en: “...Are you explaining her behavior, or laughing at me?”

zh_CN: 「两边都有一点吧。」
en: “A little of both.”

zh_CN: 「不过，她不是讨厌认真工作的医生。只是有些事，最好让她自己决定要不要讲。」
en: “But she doesn't dislike doctors who take their work seriously. There are just some things she should be allowed to decide for herself whether to talk about.”

zh_CN: 「你和她以前，到底发生过什么？」
en: “What exactly happened between you two back then?”

zh_CN: 「医生。这句话应该去问御園医生，不是问我。」
en: “Doctor. That's a question for Dr. Misono, not me.”

zh_CN: 「有时候她会去天台透透气。如果真想和她说话……先想好要问什么，别再拿『喝杯茶』当开场白啦。」
en: “Sometimes she goes up to the rooftop for some air. If you really want to talk to her... think about what you want to ask first. Don't open with 'a cup of tea' again.”

zh_CN: 「你怎么连这个都知道？」
en: “How do you even know about that?”

zh_CN: 「这里可是护士站。消息比检验报告传得还快。」
en: “This is the nurses' station. News travels faster than lab reports here.”

zh_CN: 朝仓笑着转身继续工作。坂口没问到旧事，却得到了一个比敲会诊系统更有用的地点。
en: Asakura turns back to her work with a smile. Sakaguchi has learned nothing about the past, but he has found a more useful place to try than the consultation system.

zh_CN: 天台上的风比楼下凉一些。御園芹香独自站在栏杆旁，手里没有影像报告。
en: The breeze on the rooftop is cooler than downstairs. Serika Misono stands alone by the railing, without an imaging report in her hands.

zh_CN: 「……你又来了。」
en: “...You again.”

zh_CN: 「原来你认得我。」
en: “So you do recognize me.”

zh_CN: 「你在走廊叫过我，在休息室里也来找过我。我总不至于连这种事都记不住。」
en: “You called to me in the corridor, and you came to see me in the lounge. I'm hardly going to forget that.”

zh_CN: 「这么说，上次你真的听见了。」
en: “So you really did hear me last time.”
“Yes.”

zh_CN: 「……回答得还真干脆。」
en: “...That's a very straightforward answer.”

zh_CN: 「如果还是来问我喝不喝茶，你可以现在回去。」
en: “If you're here to ask whether I want tea again, you can leave now.”

zh_CN: 「不，这次是工作上的事。我看了你写的术后影像报告。」
en: “No, it's work this time. I read your postoperative imaging report.”

zh_CN: 「哪一份？」
en: “Which one?”

zh_CN: 「你特别标出了术野附近血管走向的那份。正文只有几行，附图倒是做得很细。」
en: “The one where you highlighted the vessel running near the surgical field. Just a few lines of text, but very detailed annotated images.”

zh_CN: 「外科会不会真的去看，是另外一回事。」
en: “Whether Surgery actually looks at them is another matter.”

zh_CN: 「我看了。那条血管如果按一般位置处理，很容易看错。」
en: “I did. It would be easy to misidentify that vessel if you assumed it was in the usual position.”

zh_CN: 「既然看出来了，手术时就别弄错。」
en: “Since you noticed, don't get it wrong during surgery.”

zh_CN: 「你说话真不留情面。」
en: “You really don't soften your words.”

zh_CN: 「片子不需要我留情面。」
en: “The images don't need me to.”

zh_CN: 「说起来，星见的术后复查是不是经常漂亮得有点过分？」
en: “Come to think of it, don't postoperative scans at Hoshimi often look a little too perfect?”

zh_CN: 「我刚来这里时，以为有人把术前和术后的片子贴反了。」
en: “When I first came here, I thought someone had swapped the preoperative and postoperative labels.”

zh_CN: 「然后？」
en: “And then?”

zh_CN: 「重新核对病历、时间、患者编号。全部对得上。」
en: “I checked the records, the times, and the patient IDs again. Everything matched.”

zh_CN: 「那不是很好吗？」
en: “Isn't that a good thing?”

zh_CN: 「从医疗结果来说，很好。从影像科医生的精神健康来说，有点难评价。」
en: “For the medical outcome, very good. For the radiologist's mental health, it's harder to say.”

zh_CN: 她终于把目光转向坂口。这次既没有绕开他，也没有立刻结束谈话。
en: At last, she turns her gaze toward Sakaguchi. This time she neither avoids him nor immediately ends the conversation.

zh_CN: 「御園芹香。你知道我的名字了，但我还是正式说一次。」
en: “Serika Misono. You already know my name, but I should introduce myself properly.”

zh_CN: 「坂口隆司，外科。以后影像有不明白的地方，可以直接来问你吗？」
en: “Ryuji Sakaguchi, Surgery. If there's something in the images I don't understand, may I come and ask you directly?”

zh_CN: 「可以。工作上的问题，我会回答。」
en: “Yes. I'll answer questions about work.”

zh_CN: 「那工作以外——」
en: “And outside work—”

zh_CN: 「不用问。」
en: “Don't ask.”

zh_CN: 芹香转回视线，仿佛刚才只是完成了一次简短会诊。可这回，她至少没有把坂口当成走廊里的空气。
en: Serika looks away again, as though she has merely finished a brief consultation. But this time, at least, she hasn't treated Sakaguchi like empty air in the corridor.
